answer.explanation: The visible log events show normal invocations across all four functions: no timeouts, errors or out-of-memory messages, and REPORT durations are consistent within each function. Max Memory Used stays well under the configured size (CrudApi about 91-97 MB of 256 MB, Uploader about 96-100 MB of 256 MB, Thumbnailer and Compression about 110 MB and 102 MB of 1024 MB). The Thumbnailer and Compression functions are over-provisioned on memory, but that is a cost observation, not a configuration anomaly. About 4,350 events were truncated, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
